column1: # Species named in domande2024.pdf, used by tools/fetch_photos.py.
#   name       scientific name shown in the app
#   topic      PDF section prefix (Be, Am, ... ) or "-" for look-alikes named in groups B/C
#   common     Italian common name (from the PDF when it gives one), or "-"
#   muse       name used by the MUSE Bresadola gallery when different, "-" if same, "none" to use Wikimedia
#   lookalike  comma-separated names of species easily confused with this one (used as wrong answers)
#   aliases    other names used in the PDF text, comma separated, or "-"
#   edibility  commestibile | non commestibile | sospetto | tossico | mortale (PDF answers, then standard Italian classification)
#   note       short safety note shown with the badge, or "-"
#   universoalpino  page slug on universoalpino.com with more photos (used with permission), or "-"
